claimScopes.clm-nus-ai-marking-approval: Institutional teaching governance for instructors; prior approval required via AI System for Assurance and Evaluation. In general, except for AI marking of objective or closed-ended assessments, a human reviewer should remain in the loop; spot checks should still be conducted. Failure to comply with this section may constitute a breach of University policy and may be addressed through the relevant staff governance processes.

title.en: Check course instructions and disclose AI assistance.
title.zh: 核对课程说明并披露 AI 辅助。

scope.en: Take-home use is allowed by default with disclosure, subject to course instructions. ChatGPT Edu access is separate from assessment permission and sensitive-data approval. NUS Press rules concern submissions to that publisher.
scope.zh: 非监督作业默认允许 AI 并须披露，仍须遵守课程说明。ChatGPT Edu 可用不代表作业或敏感资料获准；NUS Press 规则仅适用于该出版社投稿。

do.en: Check the exact assignment and audience.
do.zh: 核对具体作业要求及适用对象。

do.en: Follow disclosure instructions and applicable exceptions.
do.zh: 遵守披露要求及适用例外。

do.en: Check data classification and tool mode.
do.zh: 核对资料分类与工具模式。

dont.en: Do not infer assessment permission from tool access.
dont.zh: 不要把工具可用当作作业许可。

dont.en: Do not infer sensitive-data approval from no-training terms.
dont.zh: 不要用不训练承诺推定敏感资料获准。

dont.en: Do not extend a course or publisher rule to the entire university.
dont.zh: 不要把课程或出版社规则推广到全校。
